INDEPENDENT. UNOFFICIAL. FREE.

How to use Fieldnotes

  1. Search a place or choose an area at the top.
  2. Tap a result or a map pin to open its details. Numbered circles zoom into groups of pins.
  3. Star places, mark them found or save a private note. Use “Show all” to reset the view.

Fieldnotes is an independent fan companion for Grand Theft Auto VI. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Rockstar Games or Take-Two.

Three basemaps — read each honestly.

Our map (the default) is drawn by NextEleven: our own cartography of Leonida, vectorised from the community reconstruction and checked town-by-town against Rockstar’s official printed map. Pins are native to this map — they sit exactly where the source data puts them. It comes in day and night editions; the ◐ button swaps them.

Official is Rockstar’s own printed map of Leonida, shown under fan use (© Rockstar Games; we will remove it on request). Pins reach it through a measured transform fitted on 58 cross-checked places — expect the right neighbourhood, not the exact street corner.

Community is the original YANIS / gta6map pre-release reconstruction, kept for its street detail.

On every basemap, the landmark pins come from the current GTADB community dataset — names are current, positions are community-reported and approximate. A sourced guide without reliable coordinates is deliberately left unpinned.

Map data © GTADB.ORG contributors, CC BY 4.0 — GTA VI Landmarks Data (CC BY 4.0) — https://map.gtadb.org. Community reconstruction: YANIS / gta6map community, publisher-declared public domain.

“Official” means Rockstar names the region. “Confirmed” means multiple published launch guides agree on a discovery. “Reported” means one linked guide describes it. None of these means we personally verified its location in-game.

Your notes, found places and private pins stay in this browser. There is no cloud sync. Export a backup before clearing browser data or changing devices.

Designed & built by Baxter McDonnell · NextEleven. Grand Theft Auto and related names belong to their respective owners. The community basemap source declares its own tiles public domain; the landmark dataset is GTADB.ORG’s, used under CC BY 4.0. Rockstar’s official map artwork is © Rockstar Games, shown here under fan use only — not affiliated, not endorsed, and removable on request.
